source.name: Hurricane Pike
source.description:
+20% Attack speed, +200 ranged carrier‘s attack range.

Active ability: Activated when there is an enemy chess piece in close proximity
Push nearby enemy to the farthest grid in the opposite direction, and push oneself to the farthest grid. Ranged carriers will also immediately perform 4 distance-ignoring attacks on the target.
